items.source: An explicit bean name is defined in a global declaration of @SqlConfig.

items.source: Every attribute in @SqlConfig has an implicit default value which is documented in the javadocs of the corresponding attribute. Due to the rules defined for annotation attributes in the Java Language Specification, it is unfortunately not possible to assign a value of null to an annotation attribute. Thus, in order to support overrides of inherited global configuration, @SqlConfig attributes have an explicit default value of either "" for Strings, {} for arrays, or DEFAULT for Enums. This approach allows local declarations of @SqlConfig to selectively override individual attributes from global declarations of @SqlConfig by providing a value other than "", {}, or DEFAULT.
items.translation: `@SqlConfig` 中的每个属性都有一个在相应属性的 javadoc 中记录的**隐式**默认值。由于 Java 语言规范中定义的注解属性规则，不幸的是无法将 `null` 赋值给注解属性。因此，为了支持对**继承的**全局配置的覆盖，`@SqlConfig` 属性具有一个**显式**的 `default` 值：对于 String 为 `""`，对于数组为 `{}`，对于枚举为 `DEFAULT`。这种方法允许通过提供不同于 `""`、`{}` 或 `DEFAULT` 的值，使 `@SqlConfig` 的本地声明能够选择性地覆盖全局 `@SqlConfig` 声明中的各个属性。

items.source: When declared as a class-level annotation on an integration test class, @SqlConfig serves as global configuration for all SQL scripts within the test class hierarchy. When declared directly via the config attribute of the @Sql annotation, @SqlConfig serves as local configuration for the SQL scripts declared within the enclosing @Sql annotation.
items.translation: 当在集成测试类上声明为类级注解时，`@SqlConfig` 充当该测试类层次结构中所有 SQL 脚本的全局配置。当通过 `config` 属性直接在 `@Sql` 注解上声明时，`@SqlConfig` 充当包含在外部 `@Sql` 注解中声明的 SQL 脚本的局部配置。

items.source: Global @SqlConfig attributes are inherited whenever local @SqlConfig attributes do not supply an explicit value other than "", {}, or DEFAULT. Explicit local configuration therefore overrides global configuration.
items.translation: 全局 `@SqlConfig` 属性在本地 `@SqlConfig` 属性未提供除 `""`、`{}` 或 `DEFAULT` 之外的显式值时会被继承。因此，显式的本地配置会覆盖全局配置。
